from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    earnings_before_income_taxes: float | None = Field(description="Earnings before income taxes value (positive or negative)")
    income_tax_expense: float | None = Field(description="Income tax expense or benefit value (positive for expense, negative for benefit)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim quote containing the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancials]
